title: South Florida nightlife this weekend
igCaption:
Start with hoodie weather, then add Wynwood pizza, Coral Gables dinner, and a new late-night spot in Wynwood.
Nov 12-15, South Florida

Sources: Secret Miami, Food & Wine, Miami New Times

#MiamiNightlife #MiamiWeekend #Wynwood #SouthFlorida

scenes.text: This weekend starts with hoodie weather, then moves to Wynwood pizza, Coral Gables dinner, and a new late-night spot in Wynwood.
Friday night drops to around 59 degrees. Saturday is sunny with a high near 73 degrees. Miami has not dipped below 60 degrees since March 22.
scenes.caption: Friday night drops to around 59°. Saturday is sunny with a high near 73°. Miami has not dipped below 60° since March 22.

scenes.text: For a Wynwood dinner stop, Francesco Martucci is at 10 NE 27th St. Food & Wine named it Florida’s must-try pizzeria, and 50 Top Pizza ranked it No. 27 in the world.
scenes.caption: For a Wynwood dinner stop, Francesco Martucci is at 10 NE 27th St. Food & Wine named it Florida’s must-try pizzeria, and 50 Top Pizza ranked it No. 27 in the world.

scenes.text: If Coral Gables is your dinner move, Eating House has been around 14 years. State inspectors closed it on Wednesday, November 4, and it reopened the next morning after a callback inspection at 9:52. If you end up at Eating House, check NEAR for who’s there.
scenes.caption: If Coral Gables is your dinner move, Eating House has been around 14 years. State inspectors closed it on Wednesday, Nov. 4, and it reopened the next morning after a callback inspection at 9:52. If you end up at Eating House, check NEAR for who’s there.

scenes.text: For the late-night watchlist, Bronco opens in early December at 23rd Street and N. Miami Ave. The former Oasis space is 45,000 square feet, with a 350-seat saloon and a mechanical bull.

scenes.text: Pick the dinner stop or the late-night spot. In a night out, the person you noticed at the bar but never met is exactly the kind of moment NEAR turns into a name.
